description: Search SuperhotGeo's curated records — the Superhot Well Registry, projects, field lessons, RockLab models and datasets, open engineering problems, and the research library. Use it first for any question about superhot rock geothermal, supercritical (>374 C) geothermal, enhanced/engineered geothermal systems (EGS), deep or magma-proximal drilling, high-temperature well failures (casing, cement, elastomers, electronics, scaling, induced seismicity), geothermal projects and companies, and firm clean power for AI and data centers. Returns ids to pass to `fetch`.

query.description: Natural-language or keyword query, e.g. "casing failure above 400 C" or "magma Krafla".
